title: The fixed native encoding preserves bounded constructible generators
statement: Let ell be prime and let T be a Noetherian scheme. Use the native locally finite adic coefficient ring and the specified encoding into module objects over the pulled-back finite-subextension condensed algebraic closure of Q_ell [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework, lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-ordinary-operations]. The ordinary derived encoding carries every bounded complex with native constructible cohomology to a bounded complex with constructible module-object cohomology [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Here constructible module objects mean a finite stratification with pro-etale locally finitely presented restrictions, as in the adopted source library. This is a one-way inclusion of generator classes, for the specified encoding, with no proper morphism, coproduct conclusion, or absolute separatedness assumption.

source.place: Proper direct image bullet; native generator comparison in step 4 of lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-sums.

proof.text: Under the specified encoding [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-ordinary-operations], the regular native module becomes the regular condensed module: the underlying map is the identity followed by scalar restriction along coefficientIso. Use Mod.regularIsoComapRegular. The encoding is additive and an equivalence, hence preserves finite biproducts. Applying it to the finite sum of regular modules identifies every finite free module with the finite free module of the same rank, including rank zero.

For each native lisse module, shrink the covering presieve to a small pro-etale cover. The specified pullComparison and the finite-free isomorphism of step 1 identify each pulled-back encoded module with a finite free module, whose zero presentation proves finite presentation. Condensed pullback is raw mapMod pullback followed by extension along the coefficient isomorphism alpha. Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv and Mod.comapComp identify its restriction back along alpha with raw pullback. Finite presentation is invariant under this scalar restriction and under isomorphism. Thus encoded lisse modules are pro-etale locally finitely presented.

A Noetherian scheme is qcqs. Apply the existing source theorem IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.isAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf in Adic.ExtensionByZero. It globalizes local native stratifications by finite open covering and constructible locally closed differences. Reindex its finite strata by Fin n and use the same schemes, immersions, constructibility, coverage, and disjointness to form Scheme.Stratification. On each stratum apply step 2, pullComparison, and scalar restriction along the coefficient isomorphism. This gives exactly the raw-pullback local finite presentations required by IsConstructibleModuleObject.

The specified encoding is exact. Functor.bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj preserves boundedness, and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies each cohomology object with the encoding of the original native cohomology. Apply step 3 and transport constructibility along this isomorphism. The two clauses together prove boundedConstructible of the derived image.

lean.statement:
theorem encoding_boundedConstructible (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] :
    DerivedCategory.boundedAdicConstructible l T ≤
      (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) T)).inverseImage
        (derivedEncoding l T)
